summary: Acquires a mutex (this+0xF0) with timeout this+0xF4, writes parameter a2 to the integer field at this+0xEC, releases the mutex, and returns a pointer to the written field. Thread-safe write accessor for a shared integer field.

operations.description: Mutex handle at this+0xF0 must be non-NULL before waiting.
WaitForSingleObject(mutexHandle, this+0xF4 timeout); proceed when return is 0 (WAIT_OBJECT_0) or 128 (WAIT_ABANDONED), otherwise result is NULL.
Write a2 to the integer field at this+0xEC through the result pointer; a NULL result on a failed wait yields a null-pointer write.
ReleaseMutex(mutexHandle at this+0xF0) when the handle is non-NULL.
Return pointer to the written field this+0xEC (or ReleaseMutex result).
